phase: before clone performance measurements and optimization
measurement: Two reversed stage repetitions; each report alternates independent jsdom/rustdom process order; nine measured samples and three warmups per worker. Preserve 36 raw samples per engine, stage, node and workload row. Full public operation, bridge and result consumption are timed; setup, correctness checks, cleanup and GC are excluded.
evaluation: Compare pooled sample medians against checkpoint 65 for every row separately. An over-budget row remains open for investigation and repeat measurement; aggregate wins do not cancel regressions. Record all results, including failed candidates. The budget is a regression target against the existing hybrid runtime, not a claim of superiority over jsdom.
